AI_Tell: Em-dash used anywhere (headline body button quote caption alt)
Why_It_Reads_AI: Em-dash is the #1 LLM punctuation tell. Humans rarely type a true em-dash; models insert it constantly
Fix: Replace with period comma line break or regular hyphen. Zero em-dash instances allowed
Detection: grep for the em-dash glyph in all rendered text

AI_Tell: AI purple glow as default accent
Why_It_Reads_AI: Violet-to-indigo gradient glow is the default AI aesthetic; signals zero design intent
Fix: Use neutral base (Zinc Slate Stone) with one high-contrast singular accent < 80% saturation
Detection: scan for violet/indigo gradient + box-shadow glow on hero

AI_Tell: Pure black #000000 backgrounds or text
Why_It_Reads_AI: Pure black is harsh and machine-default; designers use off-black
Fix: Use off-black like zinc-950 or #0A0A0A instead of #000000

AI_Tell: Neon outer glow on cards or buttons
Why_It_Reads_AI: Outer neon glow reads as template demo not product
Fix: Use inner borders or subtle tinted shadows instead of outer glow
Detection: scan box-shadow for high-saturation glow rings

AI_Tell: Gradient text on large headers
Why_It_Reads_AI: Gradient-filled big headlines are an overused AI flourish
Fix: Use solid color headlines; reserve gradient for one small accent if any
Detection: scan bg-clip-text / text gradient on h1/h2

AI_Tell: Three equal-column feature cards
Why_It_Reads_AI: The 3-up equal card row is the canonical AI landing filler
Fix: Vary card sizing (bento asymmetric) or change the section layout family
Detection: detect 3 sibling cards with identical width classes

AI_Tell: Generic placeholder names (John Doe Sarah Chan Acme Inc)
Why_It_Reads_AI: Stock filler names signal unedited AI output
Fix: Use realistic context-appropriate names or real brand references
Detection: grep John Doe / Jane Doe / Acme / Lorem

AI_Tell: Fake-precise statistics (99.99% 1234567 10x)
Why_It_Reads_AI: Suspiciously precise unsourced numbers read as hallucinated
Fix: Use rounded honest figures or remove the metric if unverifiable
Detection: scan for 99.9% / fake big numbers without source

AI_Tell: Startup-slop verbs (Elevate Seamless Revolutionize Unleash Empower)
Why_It_Reads_AI: These hype verbs are LLM defaults and say nothing
Fix: Write specific concrete benefit copy; cut the hype verb
Detection: grep Elevate|Seamless|Revolutionize|Unleash|Empower

AI_Tell: Version label in hero (V0.6 BETA ALPHA) without launch context
Why_It_Reads_AI: Decorative version badges are filler unless the brief is a launch
Fix: Remove version label unless the page is genuinely a launch announcement
Detection: scan hero for V0.x / BETA / ALPHA pills

AI_Tell: Section-number eyebrows (001 Capabilities)
Why_It_Reads_AI: Numbered section eyebrows are a recognizable AI pattern
Fix: Drop the number; use a plain descriptive eyebrow or none
Detection: grep eyebrow text matching ^00\\d

AI_Tell: Decorative status dots by default
Why_It_Reads_AI: Random green/pulse status dots add fake liveliness
Fix: Remove decorative dots; only show status indicators tied to real state
Detection: scan for small colored dot spans near labels

AI_Tell: Scroll cues (Scroll down Scroll to explore)
Why_It_Reads_AI: Explicit scroll prompts are dated AI hero filler
Fix: Remove scroll cue; trust the viewport edge to imply scroll
Detection: grep Scroll to explore / Scroll down

AI_Tell: Locale/time/weather strip without place focus
Why_It_Reads_AI: Time/weather strips are decorative unless the brief is place-based
Fix: Remove the strip unless location/time is core to the product
Detection: scan header for clock/weather widget

AI_Tell: Fake product screenshots built from div rectangles
Why_It_Reads_AI: Hand-rolled div mockups look fake and break under content
Fix: Use generated images real photography (picsum seed) or honest placeholder slots
Detection: detect nested divs styled to mimic an app screenshot

AI_Tell: Overlay label pills on top of images
Why_It_Reads_AI: Floating label pills over photos are a stock AI composite
Fix: Put labels in real layout structure not overlaid on imagery
Detection: scan absolute-positioned pills over img

AI_Tell: More than one marquee per page
Why_It_Reads_AI: Multiple horizontal marquees read as filler motion
Fix: Keep at most one marquee per page
Detection: count marquee/auto-scroll strips per page

AI_Tell: Split-header (left headline + right explainer paragraph)
Why_It_Reads_AI: The split section header is an overused AI composition
Fix: Use a vertical stacked section header instead
Detection: detect 2-col header with headline left text right

AI_Tell: Three or more consecutive zigzag (image-left/text-right) sections
Why_It_Reads_AI: Repeated alternating rows feel templated
Fix: Cap zigzag at 2 consecutive; vary layout families
Detection: count consecutive alternating image/text sections

AI_Tell: Bento grid with empty cells (cells != item count)
Why_It_Reads_AI: Empty bento cells signal a copied grid not real content
Fix: N items = N cells exactly; no empty filler cells
Detection: compare bento cell count to item count

AI_Tell: Eyebrow overuse (more than ceil(sections/3))
Why_It_Reads_AI: An eyebrow on every section is mechanical AI styling
Fix: Limit uppercase-tracking eyebrows to at most ceil(sections/3)
Detection: count uppercase tracking eyebrow instances vs section count

AI_Tell: More than one accent color per project
Why_It_Reads_AI: Multiple competing accents look unconsidered
Fix: One accent maximum; lock it across the whole page
Detection: count distinct high-saturation accents in tokens

AI_Tell: Default Inter without consideration
Why_It_Reads_AI: Inter-by-default is the universal AI font tell
Fix: Reach past Inter deliberately (Geist Outfit Satoshi) or justify the choice
Detection: check font-family equals Inter with no rationale

AI_Tell: Trendy serif default (Fraunces Instrument Serif) without editorial brief
Why_It_Reads_AI: These serifs are AI go-to display fonts
Fix: Use serif only when brand or editorial/luxury aesthetic justifies it
Detection: grep Fraunces / Instrument_Serif in font config

AI_Tell: Mixed serif injected into a sans headline for variety
Why_It_Reads_AI: Random typeface mixing for visual interest reads AI
Fix: Emphasize with italic or bold within the same family
Detection: detect serif span inside sans headline

AI_Tell: Premium-consumer cliche palette (beige + brass + oxblood + espresso)
Why_It_Reads_AI: This warm luxury default is an overused AI palette
Fix: Rotate to cold luxury forest cobalt terracotta or monochrome
Detection: scan palette for beige/brass/oxblood combo

AI_Tell: Hero does not fit viewport (headline > 2 lines subtext > 4 lines)
Why_It_Reads_AI: Overflowing hero content signals no layout discipline
Fix: Headline <= 2 lines subtext <= 20 words <= 4 lines CTA above fold
Detection: measure hero block height vs viewport

AI_Tell: Excessive hero top padding (content floats mid-page)
Why_It_Reads_AI: Huge top padding pushing the hero down is AI default spacing
Fix: Cap hero top padding at pt-24 desktop
Detection: check hero top padding > pt-24

AI_Tell: Motion claimed but page is static
Why_It_Reads_AI: Promising animation then shipping a static page is a tell
Fix: If motion intensity > 4 the page must actively animate
Detection: verify declared motion matches actual animations

AI_Tell: window.addEventListener scroll for animation
Why_It_Reads_AI: Manual scroll listeners are janky and a code smell
Fix: Use IntersectionObserver useScroll ScrollTrigger or CSS scroll-driven animation
Detection: grep addEventListener('scroll')

AI_Tell: Animation without prefers-reduced-motion guard
Why_It_Reads_AI: Unguarded motion ignores accessibility and reads as careless
Fix: Wrap motion > intensity 3 in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference
Detection: check media query / useReducedMotion present

AI_Tell: Plain-text wordmarks in a logo wall
Why_It_Reads_AI: Text-only logo walls look like placeholders
Fix: Use real SVG logos (Simple Icons devicon) or generated marks under the hero
Detection: scan logo wall for text vs svg

AI_Tell: Hand-rolled decorative SVG illustrations
Why_It_Reads_AI: Custom decorative SVG blobs read as AI filler
Fix: Use generated imagery or real photos; only single geometric marks allowed
Detection: detect complex decorative inline svg

AI_Tell: Mixing multiple design systems in one tree
Why_It_Reads_AI: Mixing Material + shadcn + Bootstrap signals no system choice
Fix: Choose one design system per project and stay consistent
Detection: detect class prefixes from multiple UI systems

AI_Tell: Duplicate CTA intent with different labels (Contact us vs Get in touch)
Why_It_Reads_AI: Same intent worded differently across the page reads unedited
Fix: One label per intent across the whole page
Detection: group CTA labels by intent and flag duplicates

AI_Tell: h-screen instead of min-h-[100dvh] on full-height sections
Why_It_Reads_AI: h-screen breaks on mobile browser chrome; dvh is the considered choice
Fix: Use min-h-[100dvh] for full-height sections
Detection: grep h-screen on hero/full sections
